Step 2: Add 2 more days → total added = 121 days.  
Step 3: Start date: 1394-11-25. Add 121 days.  
Step 4: 1394-11-25 + 5 days → 1394-11-30 (5 days added, 116 left).  
Step 5: November has 30 days, so 1394-12-01 (6 days added, 115 left).  
Step 6: December has 31 days → 1395-01-01 (37 days added, 84 left).  
Step 7: January has 31 days → 1395-02-01 (68 days added, 53 left).  
Step 8: February 1395 is not a leap year (1395 mod 4 = 3) → 28 days → 1395-03-01 (96 days added, 25 left).  
Step 9: March has 31 days → 1395-03-26 (25 days added, 0 left).
